text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On Christmas Day. When I headed to the 
venue with Smart Falcon for a fan 
handshake event—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Chatter, chatter, buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a huge crowd...! Is there an 
event for a super-popular idol or 
something?
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's an event for that Uma-dol, 
Falco?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh!? Everyone here is... Falco's fan!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...! I see~... I'm so happy...!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"You are 2 minutes and 40 seconds behind 
scheduled arrival. Please hurry to the 
waiting room."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Flash-san? Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's not just me. There are others—

text_block_list.name: Dirt Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
This is the standby queue! The merchandise 
line is on the opposite side!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, too...? Could it be you're all 
helping out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When we announced the handshake event, I 
told her that Umamusume who had raced with 
her offered to help out.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone seems grateful to you for all you 
have done for the dirt tracks.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I heard earlier that you were wondering if 
there was anything you could do to help.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... *sniff*. Jeez, don't make me 
cry~.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you as well, Flash-san☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...My schedule just happened to be open, 
so please, don't worry about it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"In any case, delaying any longer will 
disrupt the schedule. Let us hurry to the 
waiting room."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so the meet-and-greet began. With more 
than double the expected number of fans 
gathered, each and every one of them 
burning with incredible passion—

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah... so cute!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks☆

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm a 'February newcomer' fan, but I 
really, truly love Falco-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you run full speed aiming for the 
top always gives me so much energy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy~♪ I'll keep on running with 
all my might☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I-Is everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, a notepad... let's see, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "I like you."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks☆ I heard your wordless feelings 
loud and clear♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Please keep supporting me from now on, 
too. Thank you for working up the courage 
to come today!

text_block_list.name: Moved Fan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeeesh!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text: Big siiis!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"W-Woah, you're the one from the 
riverbank! You came after all☆"

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Big Sis, you're sparkling today too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you☆ I'm so, so happy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for putting so many sparkly 
stickers on the letter too ☆ It was super 
cute ♪

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~. You know what? I found a dream!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
When I grow up, I'm gonna be an umadol 
just like Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
Someday, let's sing together! Just wait 
for me, okay!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll be waiting♪ Right up on that 
sparkling stage...!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I love the sheer power when she runs! 
She's so cool and so cute... I love 
Falco~!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Falco's hard work gave me the push I 
needed... It made me want to just run with 
reckless abandon.

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Falco-chan. Thank you for 
becoming an Umadol...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, thank *you*! Thank you…… for finding 
me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Smart Falcon drew strength 
directly from her many fans. At the final 
talk show...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—To be honest, Falco's been getting a 
little anxious lately.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have to win, I have to become the top. 
That's all that's on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is gonna hype up the dirt scene! 
...Maybe I'm getting a little too worked 
up, though."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: It's all good~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you☆ Yep, I'm totally, 
completely fine right now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because I was able to look everyone 
straight in the eye!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I have so many warm lights following right 
behind me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, you know, I realized it all over 
again. That being at the very top wasn't 
what mattered most.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What's important is taking everyone's 
feelings and letting Falco shine her 
absolute brightest!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco is the Umadol of the dirt, and an 
Umadol for everyone☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, to great fanfare, the Christmas 
handshake event came to a close. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At long last, the final race, the Tokyo 
Daishoten is here!
